remarks: This stunning, 4 level townhouse is located in the desirable Mid City neigborhood of Stamford. Step inside and be amazed by the modern design and luxurious finishes that have been carefully chosen throughout the home. Boasting a total living area of 1485 sq ft, the main floor offers an open and bright living room/dining room with a slider to the deck., perfect for a morning cup of coffee. Enjoy the custom cabinets and upscale stainless steel appliances in the kitchen along with granite countertops. On the second level you'll find two full bedrooms with walk in closets and a full bath. Journey to the upper level to find the primary suite which has its own private rooftop deck, perfect for a relaxing evening. The primary suite also includes a luxurious bath with marble floors and a large walk in closet. Additionally the home is equipped with a one car garageand plenty of storage. With its convenient location close to downtown shops, restaurants and more, this 2016 townhouse is the perfect place to call home.
